build_mpo_learner: build a python module to instantiate an MPOLearner for discrete or continuous policy reinforcement learning
create_training_state: create a TrainingState namedtuple to hold MPO learner parameters, optimizer states, and step counts
run_sgd_step: run a single SGD step to update MPO learner parameters and dual parameters using replay data
compute_distributional_loss: compute the critic distributional loss for MoG, non-distributional, or categorical critic types
review_mpo_loss_fn: review the MPO loss function combining policy loss, critic loss, and optional model rollout losses
